title: Remains In Motion
medium: 155 mm artillery shells, brass from artillery shells, brass from pounded artillery shells, powder coat, concrete

said.q: I wanted to create something in parallel with this idea of material reincarnation. In Vietnam's Quảng Trị province, these unexploded bombs are everywhere, being reused as planters in coffee shops or people's gardens and backyards. One of the ways that people made a living after the war was to forage and sell this material as scrap.

The work comprises two parts: an upright artillery shell mounted on a small concrete plinth, from which a delicate structure extends in slender brass arcs and reflective discs. The bomb casing anchors the work in its material history, while the suspended forms above appear almost weightless—a fragile constellation of brass discs and wires that shifts with every breath of air.
